2025</font></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New range of $10.45 to $11.15</font></div><div style="text-indent:-4.5pt"><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">WESTCHESTER, Ill., May&#160;5, 2026</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%"> &#8211; Ingredion Incorporated (NYSE&#58; INGR), a leading global provider of ingredient solutions to the food and beverage manufacturing industry, today reported its first quarter 2026 results.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;While we expected a challenging first quarter after last year&#8217;s strong first quarter, results were weaker than anticipated in Food &#38; Industrial Ingredients&#8211;U.S.&#47;CAN due to operational challenges at our Argo facility,&#8221; said Jim Zallie, chairman, president and CEO of Ingredion. &#8220;At the same time, performance in our Texture &#38; Healthful Solutions and Food &#38; Industrial Ingredients&#8211;LATAM segments were in line with our expectations despite an increasingly uncertain macroeconomic environment.&#8221;</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;Texture &#38; Healthful Solutions delivered an eighth consecutive quarter of broad-based net sales volume growth driven by continued strong customer demand for our solutions portfolio, including clean label ingredients.&#8221;</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;Food &#38; Industrial Ingredients&#8211;LATAM delivered as expected, reflecting disciplined execution across the region, while absorbing the year-over-year impact of Mexican foreign exchange headwinds.&#8221;</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;In our Food &#38; Industrial Ingredients&#8211;U.S.&#47;CAN business, while we anticipated softer customer demand, a longer-than-expected recovery at our Argo facility negatively impacted results during the quarter. We remain focused on strengthening operational reliability, and we expect performance to improve sequentially throughout the second quarter&#59; we are targeting a return to normal operations in the second half of the year.&#8221;</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;Excluding the impact of Argo, we are pleased with the performance and resilience of the other parts of our business, especially our Texture &#38; Healthful Solutions segment which continues to find opportunities for growth. Our focus going forward remains on servicing our customers, delivering innovative solutions, and driving long-term value creation for our shareholders.&#8221;</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">*</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14pt">Reported results are in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles &#8220;GAAP.&#8221; Adjusted financial measures are non-GAAP financial measures. Texture &#38; Healthful Solutions operating income is now expected to be up low single-digits, driven by sales volume growth, partially offset by expected higher input cost inflation&#59; Food &#38; Industrial Ingredients</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'null',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8211;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">LATAM operating income is now expected to be down low single-digits reflecting the continued strength of the Mexican peso&#59; and All Other operating income is still anticipated to improve by $5 to $10 million from the prior year. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Corporate costs for full-year 2026 are now expected to be flat.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">For full-year 2026, the Company now expects a reported effective tax rate of 26.3% to 27.8%, and an adjusted effective tax rate of 26.0% to 27.5%.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Cash from operations for full-year 2026 is expected to now be in the range of $725 million to $825 million reflecting our updated outlook. Capital expenditures for the full year are expected to be approximately $400 to $440 million.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Second Quarter 2026 Outlook</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">For the second quarter of 2026, compared to the same quarter last year, the Company expects net sales to be flat to up low single-digits. A replay will be available for a limited time at https&#58;&#47;&#47;ir.ingredionincorporated.com&#47;financial-information&#47;quarterly-results.</font></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">About Ingredion</font></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Ingredion Incorporated (NYSE&#58; INGR), headquartered in the suburbs of Chicago, is a leading global ingredient solutions provider serving customers in nearly 120 countries. With 2025 annual net sales of approximately $7.2 billion, the Company turns grains, fruits, vegetables and other plant-based materials into value-added ingredient solutions for the food, beverage, animal nutrition, brewing and industrial markets. With Ingredion Idea Labs</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">&#174;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> innovation centers located around the world </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font><br></font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">INGREDION REPORTS FIRST QUARTER 2026 RESULTS &#8211; Page 6</font></div></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">and more than 11,000 employees, the Company co-creates with customers and fulfills its purpose of bringing the potential of people, nature and technology together to make life better. Non-GAAP Information</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:0.1pt;margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">To supplement the consolidated financial results prepared in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (&#8220;GAAP&#8221;), non-GAAP historical financial measures are used, which exclude certain GAAP items such as restructuring costs, impairment charges, Mexico tax item, and other specified items. The term &#8220;adjusted&#8221; is generally used when referring to these non-GAAP financial measures.</font></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Management uses non-GAAP financial measures internally for strategic decision making, forecasting future results and evaluating current performance. By disclosing non-GAAP financial measures, management intends to provide investors with a more meaningful, consistent comparison of the Company&#8217;s operating results and trends for the periods presented. These non-GAAP financial measures are used in addition to and in conjunction with results presented in accordance with GAAP and reflect an additional way of viewing aspects of the Company&#8217;s operations that, when viewed with its GAAP results, provide a more complete understanding of factors and trends affecting its business. Expected financial measures may not reflect certain future charges, costs and&#47;or gains that are inherently difficult to predict and estimate due to their unknown timing, effect and&#47;or significance. Non-GAAP adjustments are generally made to adjusted financial measures, which increases management&#8217;s confidence in its ability to forecast adjusted financial measures than in its ability to forecast GAAP financial measures. These non-GAAP measures, including non-GAAP expected measures, should be considered as a supplement to, and not as a substitute for, or superior to, the corresponding measures calculated in accordance with GAAP.</font></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Non-GAAP financial measures are not prepared in accordance with GAAP&#59; therefore, the Company&#8217;s non-GAAP information is not necessarily comparable to similarly titled measures presented by other companies. A reconciliation of each non-GAAP financial measure to the most comparable GAAP measure is provided in the tables below.</font></div><div
